scope: annular vector ventilation and organization memory
selectionRule: All parameter selection uses development storms only.
validationUse: The legacy validation partition is diagnostic because model-design work saw earlier validation results. A new sealed cohort is required for a confirmatory acceptance claim.
decisionRule: Every gate must pass at both required leads. A failed component gate rejects HF-2 even when the combined forecast improves.
retestRule: Any revised candidate must be frozen before evaluation on a newly sealed HF-6 cohort. The viewed legacy validation storms cannot regain confirmatory status.
